# wakeling-site

The public website for **Wakeling** — an un-snoozable motion alarm for iOS.

**Generated. Do not edit by hand.** Every file here is built by
`tools/site/build.mjs` in the (private) app repo and published with
`tools/site/deploy.sh`. An edit made here is overwritten by the next deploy.

`privacy.html` and `terms.html` in particular are compiled from the same
TypeScript module the app renders on its own Legal screen, so the hosted policy
and the in-app policy cannot drift apart.
